name: user-management
description: Members + invites surface (P1+P2): member table (inline role dropdown, soft-remove), InviteDialog + PendingInvites (resend/cancel), all permission-gated. Props-driven + RBAC-agnostic; pair with rbac-roles + convex-auth.
notes: 0.2.0 (2026-05-31): P2 — invite flow added (InviteDialog email+role+message, PendingInvites resend/cancel; convex um_invites + sendInvite/cancelInvite/resendInvite/acceptInvite, 7-day token). 0.1.0: P1 members table. RBAC-agnostic by design — the slice imports no other slice's frontend; roles + resolved permissions are passed as props (wire from rbac-roles at the app level). Convex reuses rbac-roles' requirePermission/getActorPermissions. Roles admin (P3) + full-parity extras (P4) follow.
